cwe_content.cwe: CWE-79,Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')

candidate.Reason: The method processes user input (input parameter) and renders it as HTML without proper context-aware output encoding. Although StringEscapeUtils.escapeHtml4 is used, the HTML rendering may still be vulnerable to XSS if the input contains malicious content that bypasses the escaping.

The method processes user input (input parameter) and renders it as text without proper sanitization or encoding. If this output is later used in an HTML context, it could lead to XSS vulnerabilities.
